newsitem.title: FRANCE: Shareholders seek meeting with Eurotunnel.
newsitem.headline: Shareholders seek meeting with Eurotunnel.

text.p: A Eurotunnel shareholders' group said on Wednesday it wanted to meet Eurotunnel management in the coming days once details of the debt agreement with banks were known so that it could decide its position on the deal.
Shareholder approval is required for a debt deal.

"The association will carry out the necessary legal and financial analysis before deciding its position," the Eurotunnel Shareholders' Association, one of two groups fighting for a good deal for small shareholders, said in a statement.
"It will then call on its members and allies to vote in the direction that will be least unfavourable to their interest."
